liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Smokestack Lightning tease** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer notes Smokestack Lightning licks after the drums, unusual for post-drums segments; A Smokestack Lightning tease comes before Ship of Fools [5][13]
- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Reviewer ranks Jerry's Black Peter among the best they have heard him sing; Reviewer calls the Black Peter outstanding, with hot Jerry singing and playing [10][14]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): Reviewer especially liked the show opening with Promised Land [10]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer considers the first-set Peggy-O the best ever played [9]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Looks Like Rain very good [7]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Reviewer calls Dire Wolf rare for that period [13]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Played after It's All Over Now; reviewer says it wouldn't return for four more years [13]
- **Drums** (1 other source): Drums features Jerry, Bob and Phil plus road crew; Mickey plays a synthesizer-like percussion instrument [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Smokestack Lightning tease**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-04-14.sbd.miller.83717.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 4.63/5 by 30 [1]
- **gd1978-04-14.148291.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1978-04-14.147790.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 176 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1978-04-14.149542.BettyBoard.Anon.Noel.t-flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 168 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd78-04-14.sbd.clugston.7251.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 4.07/5 by 15 [6]. Said about its sound: A dropout and brief digital glitch occur in Johnny B. Goode around 0:28 [6]

## Around the show

- Venue is Virginia Tech in Blacksburg, Virginia, not West Virginia [12]
- Organizers avoided festival seating, instead selling tickets on a first come basis, to keep chaos down [16]
- Reviewer finds it weaker than other 1978 shows, with no major highs or lows [7]
- Reviewer expected a dud after hot April 12, 15 and 16 shows, but energy matched the run [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-04-14.sbd.miller.83717.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd1978-04-14.148291.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor;Tim Dalton; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: Source: SBD Master Reel (7" two track @ 7 1/2 ips - recorded by Betty Cantor) > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz > DAT (44k) - From the Tim Dalton collection. [2]
- **gd1978-04-14.147790.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kathy Sublette's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 [3]. Also: A soundboard source patches eight seconds of the Me & My Uncle > Big River transition [3]
- **gd1978-04-14.149542.BettyBoard.Anon.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by PCM provided by anonymous, while hiding out away from the Bay Area. Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel April 12, 2020; source: Source: Betty Cantor’s SBD Reel Master > Beta tape > Beta VCR > PCM [5]. Also: Betty board PCM clone via 601ESD and SPDIF; emphasis decoded, DC offset removed, with SM57 patch [5]
- **gd78-04-14.sbd.clugston.7251.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]. Also: Master soundboard 7-inch two-track reels, to PCM twice, to DAT, to CDR; mastered and shortened by Scott Clugston [6]
